note: Issue #6 (write-path cutover) verification, against the issue #5 baseline at a931bbf. Assembled from three invocations rather than one --all sweep: case 3 turns the screen off to force deep Doze, which re-locks the keyguard, and a locked device cannot foreground the app -- so cases 4, 5 and 6 reported UNREACHABLE in the first sweep. This is the two-pass split the harness header documents, not a product finding. Each case's verdict is taken from the pass that actually evaluated it; all three passes ran against the same clean commit and the same device.
